answer: To keep the garden honest, every agent must pass a ferrous gate before it can trade: it locks 500 POA as a stake for 30 days, and any proven lie or duplicate vote slashes the whole bond. A juniper hedge of slow reputation growth means a new identity earns trust only by weeks of verified work, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs 500,000 POA locked at once - far more than any single vote is worth.
